name: ava
description: Connect Codex to a scoped AVA instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped AVA tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to AVA through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so AVA Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AVA only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
